say:1:1430236201:1.text: I plan to stroll through the city, listening to both peasants and nobles. Most of all, I want to uncover what the priesthood dare not speak aloud.
say:1:1430236201:1.source_cn: 我打算在王城里逛逛，去和平民、贵族以及最神秘的祭司去聊聊。
say:1:1430236201:1.male: I plan to stroll through the city, listening to both peasants and nobles. Most of all, I want to uncover what the priesthood dare not speak aloud.
say:1:1430236201:1.female: I plan to stroll through the city, listening to both peasants and nobles. Most of all, I want to uncover what the priesthood dare not speak aloud.

say:2:1430236202:1.text: I'd much rather learn about the social structure of Sal'thorin than pick and poke at the bark of this tree!
say:2:1430236202:1.source_cn: 比起撅着屁股抠树皮，我更愿意去了解整个萨洛克兰的社会结构！
